text:
Built my first sharable Grok Bot template

🔴 LG Laundry Specialist 
https://x.ai/bot/TNPSVnX4Dm-adBvHJbng7

The problem with my LG Washtower is it only has 3-4 buttons, and LG forces you to use their app for delay start, special cycles, no dryer spin, etc. 

Well, I figured why use their app when Grok Bot can drive it?

This bot uses an LG ThinQ CLI that my Grok Bot made https://github.com/bryan-lmm/lg-thinq-grok-bot

With this CLI and this @bot  template you can just tell grok bot everything you loaded into the washer or dryer, and let Grok Bot pick the right cycle for you!

*Requires logging into LG ThinQ on @grok @bot 's computer

card.title: LG Laundry Specialist by Bryan
card.description: Maps plain-English laundry to real LG ThinQ washer and dryer cycles, then starts them once Remote Start is on. For anyone with LG ThinQ laundry machines.
